scrapers.name: Miruro
scrapers.description: Anime from miruro.tv: MegaPlay file resolution (embed -> file-id -> getSourcesNew m3u8, sub+dub in parallel) plus the site secure pipe (4-mirror ring) on device; v2.6.0 fresh-episode + dead-lane fixes: mal: catalog ids are enriched with their AniList id via ani.zip (24h cache) so MegaPlay's mal AND ani routes both resolve the same episode (one side lags less on just-aired episodes), the pipe lane is circuit-broken for 15min after a 403 hard block instead of burning 4x6s per call, and the master-probe verdict is memoized module-wide (3min) so identical master URLs from MegaPlay's ?s= hint rotation (which anime sources ignore) and the double sweep are probed once; v2.5.0 device resilience: CDN self-healing rotation, fail-open post-filter (probe failures keep rows), 10.5s overall deadline flushing partial rows, stream cache written; v2.4.0: accepts catalog-issued anime ids verbatim (mal:/anilist:/kitsu:/anikoto:) and resolves anikoto ids through the /series episode list to the exact MegaPlay s-2 embed-id routes MegaPlay's own API docs pair with them; v2.3.0: deterministic TMDB mapping via ani.zip themoviedb_id (mal+anilist in one CDN request), Kitsu/Jikan/AniList title search demoted to fallback. v2.7.0 series-fix: Nuvio hands providers the TAPPED EPISODE's id for series (Stremio protocol, "mal:61240:1:9"; bare meta id only for movies) and the old strict prefix regex rejected every decorated shape -> 0 rows for every TV/series tap while movies worked (reproduced live). parseCatalogAnimeId now tolerates all observed decorations (episode-id :s:e suffix, urlencoded %3A, path separators, trailing .json, query strings, any case), extracts the season/episode from the id when the app omits them, and auto-detects the mediaType slot so legacy 3-arg calls can no longer shift season/episode.
scrapers.author: xrexzerox

scrapers.name: Pencuri
scrapers.description: Malaysian/Indonesian/Japanese/Thai movies & series from pencurimovie.baby (paired with the asian-catalog addon's 9 Pencuri sections: Movies, Series, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand, Most Viewed, Most Rating, Top IMDb). Plays catalog rows DIRECTLY by navigating the site's real page or episode page (asian:pen-<slug> rows, zero title searching) and resolves TMDB ids by site search for everything else. v1.4.0 ENGLISH SUBTITLES on every row (opensubtitles-v3, parallel fail-soft lanes). v1.3.0 MULTI-SERVER FIX (user report: only 1 stream and its not playing - have 8 server): Streamtape /e/ pages carry TWO get_video links and the #robotlink DIV token (v1.2.0's pick) is a DECOY answering 403/500; the provider now evaluates the innerHTML expression (eval-free: string literals + chained .substring with JS semantics) to get the REAL token, which 302s to tapecontent.net (verified 720p + 1080p) and re-signs per request at play time; quality labels come from the embed page's own filename with zero extra requests. NEW StreamHG lane for hgcloud.to/hglink.to (2 of 8 servers, was an unparseable stub): loader rotates to audinifer.com whose radix-36 packed script unpacks to a signed master.m3u8 (206 verified); quality from the playlist RESOLUTION line. unpackPackedScript is now radix-aware (10..62). Dead-filler voe embeds (Big Buck Bunny placeholder, verified on the sample) are rejected via a placeholder guard. dedupeRows keys the FULL url (Streamtape file ids live in the query - the old query-strip collapsed both embeds into one row). Dood (playmogo/dsvplay) stays turnstile-aware: the gate is unconditional (verified desktop UA / mobile UA / cookie attempts), so gated pages skip in milliseconds. Lanes: MixDrop packed unpack to mxcontent.net mp4, Streamtape expression-token get_video, StreamHG signed m3u8, Dood pass_md5, Voe JS-redirect follow, inline probe for unknown hosts - all parallel, all fail-soft, all hasTimers()-guarded. Hermes-safe: no unescape/escape/btoa/atob.
scrapers.author: xrexzerox
